description: What removing would come to, shown before anything is removed.

agreement.description: What this reading names itself, so an answer says which reading it answered.

backup.description: Whether a backup was offered before configuration is destroyed, and how.

bytes.description: What the lines that are going occupy, where that is knowable.

coming.description: What is still coming down, which stopping would interrupt.

confidence.description: How much of this was read, and what could not be.

foreign.description:
What is beneath the data location that the stack did not put there.

Not a warning. While this is non-empty the data location is never removed as
one tree, and only the stack's own directories beneath it are offered.

items.description: Every line it reaches, each said to be going or said to be kept.

keeps.description: What it leaves alone, in the operator's words.

outside.description: What lemonfiber cannot remove, each with how to remove it by hand.

removes.description: What it takes, in the operator's words.

volume.description:
Whether the data location is on a network share or a drive that unplugs.

Said where it is, so removing across a mount an operator forgot was a mount is
something they read before agreeing rather than after.
